units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 90:6">Targ. Ps. XC, 6</cite>; a. v. fr.—[<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 90:10">Ib. 10</cite> <he>וטייסין לצ׳</he>, prob. to be read: <he>כצִפָּרָא</he>.]—
<cite ref="Pesachim 111b">Pes. 111ᵇ</cite> <he>בטולי דצ׳ וכ׳</he> in the morning and evening shadows of things of less than a cubit’s length.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 107b">B. Mets. 107ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b:2">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite> (prov.) <he>שתין … גברא דמצ׳ כרך</he> sixty runners may run, but will not overtake a man that takes early morning meals.
<cite ref="Taanit 22a">Taan. 22ᵃ</cite> top, a. fr. <he>לצ׳</he> when the morning came.
Targ. Ps. CI, 8 (ed. Wil. sing.).
